findings.title: Required-empty inline validation messages for employer_name still say "employer's name", re-introducing the sole-trader incoherence on the error path
findings.evidence:
|> require_non_empty(
        values,
        "employer_name",
        "Your employer\u{2019}s name, please.",
      )
... (co-applicant branch, line ~800)
      |> require_non_empty(
        values,
        co_applicant_field_key(index, "employer_name"),
        "Their employer\u{2019}s name.",
      )
findings.detail: The relabeled fields render these messages when required-but-empty. A self-employed applicant who blanks the field is re-asked for "Your employer's name" — the framing the ruling removed. Spec's I/O matrix pins only the error-summary label; not disclosed in the deferred-work ledger.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword the two messages to match the ruling (e.g. "Your employer or business name, please." / "Their employer or business name."), or record the split in deferred-work.md.
findings.verification_note: Verified verbatim at application_handler.gleam:491 and :800 — both are require_non_empty messages for employer_name / co_applicant employer_name keys. Absent from the diff's deferred-work entries. Escalated note→warning in consolidation: same bug class the fix exists to remove, on the most common error path.
findings.severity_adjusted: note -> warning (consolidation: user-facing sole-trader incoherence on the primary error path, undisclosed)
